name: Norflurane
aliases: Tetrafluoroethane, 1,1,1,2 Tetrafluoroethane, 1,1,1,2-tetrafluoroethane, Genetron 134a, HFA-134a, HFC-134a, R-134a, Suva 134a
summary: 1,1,1,2-Tetrafluoroethane (also known as norflurane (INN), R-134a, Klea 134a, Freon 134a, Forane 134a, Genetron 134a, Green Gas, Florasol 134a, Suva 134a, HFA-134a, or HFC-134a) is a hydrofluorocarbon (HFC) and haloalkane refrigerant with thermodynamic properties similar to R-12 (dichlorodifluoromethane) but with insignificant ozone depletion potential and a lower 100-year global warming potential (1,430, compared to R-12's GWP of 10,900).

pharmacology.text: 1,1,1,2-Tetrafluoroethane (also known as norflurane (INN), R-134a, Klea 134a, Freon 134a, Forane 134a, Genetron 134a, Green Gas, Florasol 134a, Suva 134a, HFA-134a, or HFC-134a) is a hydrofluorocarbon (HFC) and haloalkane refrigerant with thermodynamic properties similar to R-12 (dichlorodifluoromethane) but with insignificant ozone depletion potential and a lower 100-year global warming potential (1,430, compared to R-12's GWP of 10,900).

uses.text: For its medical uses, 1,1,1,2-tetrafluoroethane has the generic name norflurane. It is used as propellant for some metered dose inhalers. It is considered safe for this use. In combination with pentafluoropropane, it is used as a topical vapocoolant spray for numbing boils before curettage. It has also been studied as a potential inhalational anesthetic, but it is nonanaesthetic at doses used in inhalers.

summaryZh: 1,1,1,2-四氟乙烷，別名R-134a，化學式為CH2FCF3，大氣壓下的沸點為−26.3°C。是一種熱力學性質與二氟二氯甲烷類似的鹵代烷製冷劑，但與R-12相比，它的臭氧破壞潛勢更低。
summaryZhHans: 1,1,1,2-四氟乙烷，别名R-134a，化学式为CH2FCF3，大气压下的沸点为−26.3°C。是一种热力学性质与二氟二氯甲烷类似的卤代烷制冷剂，但与R-12相比，它的臭氧破坏潜势更低。

sideEffects.en: Inhaling it displaces oxygen and can suffocate. It also makes the heart more sensitive to adrenaline, so sudden death from an abnormal heart rhythm can happen even on a first use. The cold liquid can freeze the mouth and airway.
sideEffects.zh: 吸入它會排擠氧氣，可能造成窒息。它也會使心臟對腎上腺素更敏感，因此即使第一次使用也可能因心律異常而猝死。冷液體還可能凍傷口腔與呼吸道。
sideEffects.zhHans: 吸入它会排挤氧气，可能造成窒息。它也会使心脏对肾上腺素更敏感，因此即使第一次使用也可能因心律异常而猝死。冷液体还可能冻伤口腔与呼吸道。

fact.en: The same gas is the refrigerant R-134a and the propellant in many asthma inhalers. Sold for airsoft guns as green gas, it is also inhaled as a drug, which is dangerous.
fact.zh: 同一種氣體既是冷媒 R-134a，也是許多氣喘吸入器的推進劑。它以「綠氣」的名義販售給空氣槍玩家，也被人吸入當作藥物使用，這相當危險。
fact.zhHans: 同一种气体既是冷媒 R-134a，也是许多气喘吸入器的推进剂。它以「绿气」的名义贩售给空气枪玩家，也被人吸入当作药物使用，这相当危险。
